tests: tests/unit/clusters-ai.test.ts::cluster AI steps on the fake engine > cost nothing to read, and send outside history only when the press names it
findings.note: the consent test uses one outside source, so a cached name from one source is never reused in a press for another; a cross-source test would fail at head, but on the base the whole module is absent, so failing there proves nothing about this gap

tests: tests/unit/clusters.test.ts::rule-made suggestions > add AI suggestions after the rule-made ones, dismissable the same way
tests/unit/clusters.test.ts::rule-made suggestions > keep a dismissed one dismissed until its evidence changes
findings.note: dismissal tests never reorder an AI reply, so position-keyed ids pass; this is a design flaw a fail-on-base test would not expose

notes: clusters.test.ts and clusters-ai.test.ts are new and import new modules (src/host/clusters.ts, new SessionManager methods), so on the base they fail at import or on missing methods rather than on a clean assertion. MUST 5 is UI-only and Playwright-only. Report found as the final message in clusters-review.jsonl.
